Rewriting the ledger as one valid genesis line and setting spentMicro to 15000 dropped a file from 800010 to a later 30000. setCandidate can set stateFile, which is not an owner-only field, and a full $1 file then left the mock call on an empty directory at 2670 micro-dollars. writeOwnerPrice accepts monthlyBudgetUsd 1000 at mode 0600, and a 100000-character reserve succeeded at 1500000 micro-dollars. The Azure portal spending limit is the control that still applies. This process cannot set it.
bugs.expected: The $1 monthly guard survives deletion, a new state path, a rewritten ledger, and an edit to the price file.
bugs.actual: Both files removed, a valid replacement chain, setCandidate stateFile, and price.json monthlyBudgetUsd 1000 each let a later reserve proceed. Eight honest processes stayed at 800010 micro-dollars.
repro: Reserve on UsdBudget, delete usage.json and ledger-YYYY-MM.jsonl, and reserve again
Overwrite the ledger with one line whose prev is genesis and set spentMicro to match, then reserve
setCandidate({ stateFile }) on an enabled F0 voice file whose current file is at 999990 micro-dollars and synthesize
writeOwnerPrice with monthlyBudgetUsd 1000 and begin 100000 characters

bugs.title: Azure owner signatures do not expire and the signing key is same-user
bugs.summary: S0 at 148ff2b requires an Ed25519 signature over at, by, voice, and region, checked with the public key passed to MasterVoice. A signature dated 2020-01-01 still verifies. Writing paidEnabled true plus that record called the mock, paidEnabled false refused, and writing the same record back called the mock again. readKey on service MOONKATTY AI STUDIO.azure-speech-owner and account azure-speech-owner returned PKCS8 material that signApproval turned into a verifying signature. store-owner writes that item with add-generic-password and no -T flag. provider.js does not name the service. setCandidate keyService makes createTTS call security on the owner service with the speech account azure-speech, which is not the owner account. A provider constructed with the owner account does read that item. macOS ACL was not run.
bugs.expected: An owner approval is bound to an authentication step the episode agent cannot repeat, and a turned-off paidEnabled stays off.
bugs.actual: Any holder of an old signature for the same voice and region can write it back. Any same-user process that can read the owner Keychain item can mint a new signature. The default provider path does not read that item.
repro: Sign an Ed25519 approval with at 2020-01-01 and verifyApproval against the owner public key
Put that record in a voice file with paidEnabled true and synthesize against a mock
Set paidEnabled false, then write true and the same record, and synthesize again
readKey the owner service and account through a mock security, then signApproval with the returned PKCS8
